title: Filtered source bar augmentation
statement: For the source bar tower of a finite-piece diagram [def-sc-compact-flat-source-bar-tower], each canonical augmentation c_n:R_n -> L_n is a quasi-isomorphism [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules].

source.place: The source-bar, finite-cone-block, least-block adjunction and union-bar paragraphs; Filtered source bar augmentation.

proof.text: Write the full source bar as the colimit of the bars of principal lower ideals. Each lower ideal has a greatest element, so its augmentation to that diagram value is a homotopy equivalence, proved by the unit prism. These augmentations are natural. Filtered colimits of module sheaves are exact, so their colimit is a quasi-isomorphism. The generator formula for the lower-ideal colimit identifies this colimit map with the canonical sourceBarAugmentation. No bounded-diagonal or stalk argument is needed.

proof_origin.place: The principal-lower-ideal contraction and exact filtered-colimit proof, complete in Lean.
